offering_description.value: Provides cloud software for property and casualty insurers, collision repair shops, automakers and parts suppliers. Its platform combines data, AI and connections between businesses to automate claims and repair workflows.

quotes.quote: CCC cloud platform connects insurers, repairers, OEMs, and parts suppliers with AI-powered solutions for smarter claims and repair experiences.

The CCC IX Cloud connects businesses, data, and AI to create intelligent claims and repair experiences for everyone. Using event-driven technology, the IX Cloud converts data into insights and delivers them at the right time to the right people. Workflows can run concurrently instead of linearly, enabling new levels of speed and responsiveness, helping consumers get back on the road and back to health quickly.

primary_products.value: Insurance claims software; collision repair management software; automaker repair network software; digital parts sourcing and ordering tools

quotes.quote: The CCC IX Cloud platform powers our three market-facing industry solutions: CCC ONE® for repair shops, CCC for Insurance, and OEM Net™ for auto manufacturers. Together, these platforms use our AI to create intelligent experiences across the claims and repair journey – helping you restore the vehicle and return drivers to health. All three integrate seamlessly with the IX Cloud, offering configurability without the need to replace or disrupt current workflows.
Our solutions help parts suppliers sell more parts, enabling them to digitally connect to tens of thousands of body shops sourcing and ordering replacement parts while writing estimates.
